story: Tomb Raider 1 Ported to Game Boy Advance
text: > as far as i know, beyond anything on the gba ever There were actually a few commercial 3d rendered GBA games! They weren't very common, but perhaps the most graphically impressive was Asterix & Obelix XXL, a 3D platformer: [LINK] Some others are showcased here: [VIDEO]

story: Pico3D: Open World 3D Game Engine for the PicoSystem (RP2040 Microcontroller)
text: Beyond the tech demos There are dozens published 3D games. The most impressive is the GBA port of Driv3r. More or less stripped down Grand Theft Auto 3 style sandbox game, squashed down onto the GBA. Driv3r Video: [LINK] History/showcase of various 3d GBA games: [VIDEO]
